name: AI Marketplace Monitor
description: Watch Facebook Marketplace for the items you want, rate each new listing with AI, and get notified of good deals.
short_desc: Find Facebook Marketplace deals with AI.
author: BoPeng

form_fields.label: Facebook username
form_fields.hint: The Facebook account aimm logs in with. Also signs you in to the web UI.

form_fields.label: Facebook password
form_fields.hint: Password of that Facebook account. Also signs you in to the web UI.

form_fields.label: UnitySVC API key
form_fields.hint: For the default configuration: the AI that rates listings, and email and phone notifications (https://unitysvc.com). Replace the placeholder with your key; with the placeholder, aimm searches but cannot rate listings or send notifications until you set a key here or other AI and notification services in the web UI.
